svg.title: Plant I
svg.desc: Interpretive vector study after the viewed reference. Approximate geometry; framing, wall, shadows and paint texture omitted. Foundation centenary microsite (EK100), chapter 3 explicitly labels this image Plant I (1949), distinct from neighboring Plant II. Hand-drawn white plant silhouette on black rectangular field; leaf outlines approximate, paint texture and rubbed canvas edge omitted. Current primary museum size unresolved; normalized to reproduction.
